change.description:
fix(chat): search every file, map nested repos, and retry cancelled opens
fix(chat): satisfy lint and update workspace read test expectations
change.author: Dhruv Sharma

findings.title: Unbounded retry loop on cancelled workspace-file fetch
findings.body: The old code retried a CancelledError once. `for (;;)` now retries without limit and has no unmount or abort guard. Two callers await it: `resolvePaneFile` (2286) and `revealResolvedWorkspaceFile` (2560). `queryClient.cancelQueries` runs on the workspace query keys elsewhere (`SessionInspector.tsx:786`, `:921`), and the loop restarts a fetch after every cancel. A caller can therefore keep starting daemon manifest requests after the view has unmounted. It stops only when a fetch finishes without being cancelled. A bounded retry (a few attempts) or a stop condition tied to the component's lifetime would keep the "retry cancelled opens" fix and remove that exposure. No test covers the retry.

findings.title: File search no longer has any bound on the path inventory
findings.body: `math.MaxInt` removes the 20000-path cap for search. That is the stated goal ("search every file"), and `truncated` is now always false for non-scratch sessions. But `workspaceSourcePaths` still builds `changed`, `unchanged`, `seen` and `paths` for the whole inventory. It also resolves changes for every source on every keystroke-driven search request, because `includeDeleted` is true. On a very large monorepo that is unbounded memory and latency per request. The scratch branch (`scratchWorkspaceFiles`) is still capped and can still report `Truncated`, so the two branches now behave differently. Confirm that an uncapped scan is acceptable, and consider adding a test that searches a workspace with more than 20000 paths.

contracts.action: Workspace file search lists every path (no cap) for non-scratch sessions
contracts.equivalent_path: ListWorkspaceFilePaths calls workspaceSourcePaths with maxWorkspaceFilePaths and includeDeleted=false (backend/internal/service/session/workspace_file_paths.go:48)
contracts.before_after: Before: search used the same 20000 cap, so files past the cap could not be found. After: limit is MaxInt, `total > limit` is never true and `truncated` is never true. Changes are still resolved because includeDeleted is true. The result slice is unbounded, and matches are paginated by cursor and capped at 100 per page.
contracts.visible_effect: Search finds files beyond the first 20000 paths. The truncated flag no longer shows for source-backed sessions.
contracts.failure_mode: Very large repos mean more memory and latency per search request. Errors from resolveWorkspaceChanges propagate as before.

contracts.action: workspacePathSourceFor skips a nested-repo source when the path is exactly its prefix plus a slash
contracts.equivalent_path: Same function previously only checked HasPrefix(path, prefix+"/")
contracts.before_after: Before: "a/b/" matched source a/b with an empty relative path, so the change-status lookup was done on "". After: it falls back to the parent source, giving rel "b/". The new test covers both this and "a/b/x.go".
contracts.visible_effect: A directory-style entry for a nested repo maps to its parent repo instead of an empty path. Normal files are unchanged.
contracts.failure_mode: No new failure path. A path with no matching source still returns ok=false, which the caller turns into an error.

contracts.action: fetchWorkspaceFiles retries a cancelled fetch indefinitely
contracts.equivalent_path: The previous code retried once after a CancelledError
contracts.before_after: Before: one retry, then the error was thrown. After: it loops until a fetch finishes without being cancelled or fails with a non-cancel error.
contracts.visible_effect: Opening a file by relative path, or a pane file command, survives repeated cancellation of the workspace query.
contracts.failure_mode: No cap and no unmount guard, so the loop can keep starting requests while cancels continue. A non-cancel error still rejects to the caller.

summary: The change is small and mostly correct. The nested-repo prefix fix is covered by a new test, and the test expectation updates are consistent with the code. Two non-blocking concerns. The frontend retry loop in `SessionView.tsx` has no limit and no unmount guard. Search in `workspace_review.go` no longer has any cap on the path inventory.
